response.sql: WITH per_event AS (SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, SUM(spent) * 1.0 / SUM(amount) AS spend_ratio FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL AND spent IS NOT NULL AND amount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event HAVING SUM(amount) <> 0), avg_ratio AS (SELECT AVG(spend_ratio) AS avg_spend_ratio FROM per_event) SELECT p.event_id, p.spend_ratio, p.spend_ratio / a.avg_spend_ratio AS relative_ratio FROM per_event p CROSS JOIN avg_ratio a ORDER BY (relative_ratio IS NULL), relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10;
